Supplier Summary

The Supplier Summary report provides a comprehensive overview of all your suppliers and their account balances for a specified period.

This report helps you monitor outstanding payables, track payment history, and analyze supplier relationships over time.

Report Configuration

To generate the report, specify the date range you want to analyze. The report will show opening balances, total purchases, payments made, and closing balances for each supplier.

You can optionally filter the report by division to focus on suppliers associated with specific business segments or locations.

Understanding the Report

The report displays each supplier with columns showing their opening balance at the start date, total purchases during the period, payments made, and the closing balance at the end date.

Use this information to identify suppliers with large outstanding balances, review payment patterns, and ensure your records match supplier statements.

From

The starting date for the period covered by the report.

To

The ending date for the period covered by the report.

Division

Select a division to filter suppliers, or leave blank to include all divisions.
